initial_directives: Implement bounty #823: Add rebase conflict detection and resolution to GitManager in the Bounty-Hunters-h4ck3r repo. Requirements: Add conflict detection in GitManager after rebase operations by checking for .git/REBASE_HEAD presence. Create a getConflictFiles method that parses git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U output to list conflicted files. Expose a rebase.conflicts RPC event through the existing IPC system so the web UI can display conflict markers. Add abortRebase and continueRebase methods to GitManager. Error handling wraps git errors in Effect.fail with typed error tags. Tests mock git commands and verify conflict detection logic.
